(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-ray]'), p=document.querySelector('[data-photon]'), e=r.getPointAtLength(r.getTotalLength()), error=Math.hypot(e.x-Number(p.getAttribute('cx')),e.y-Number(p.getAttribute('cy'))); if(error>.02) throw Error('Ray and photon diverge: '+error); return {phase:'entering',endpointError:error};})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-ray]'),p=document.querySelector('[data-photon]'),e=r.getPointAtLength(r.getTotalLength()),error=Math.hypot(e.x-Number(p.getAttribute('cx')),e.y-Number(p.getAttribute('cy')));if(error>.02||document.querySelector('[data-step="1"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true') throw Error('Reflection interaction or path failed: '+error);return {phase:'reflecting',endpointError:error};})()
